import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date_parsed'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%Y')

anomaly_date = pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13')
before = df[df['date_parsed'] < anomaly_date]
after = df[df['date_parsed'] >= anomaly_date]

# Total delta
baseline = before[before['date_parsed'] == before['date_parsed'].max()]['unblended_cost'].sum()
anom = after[after['date_parsed'] == anomaly_date]['unblended_cost'].sum()
print(f"Baseline daily: {baseline}, Anomaly day: {anom}, Delta: {anom - baseline}")

# Resource key = all descriptive columns
key_cols = ['csp', 'cloud_service', 'application', 'instance_family']

# Compare the day before anomaly (10-12) vs anomaly day (10-13)
day_before = df[df['date_parsed'] == pd.Timestamp('2025-10-12')]
day_anom = df[df['date_parsed'] == anomaly_date]

b = day_before.groupby(key_cols).agg(price=('price','first'), num_instances=('num_instances','first'), cost=('unblended_cost','sum'))
a = day_anom.groupby(key_cols).agg(price=('price','first'), num_instances=('num_instances','first'), cost=('unblended_cost','sum'))

merged = b.join(a, how='outer', lsuffix='_before', rsuffix='_anom').fillna(0)
merged['cost_delta'] = merged['cost_anom'] - merged['cost_before']
merged['price_changed'] = merged['price_before'] != merged['price_anom']
merged['instances_changed'] = merged['num_instances_before'] != merged['num_instances_anom']

changed = merged[(merged['cost_delta'].abs() > 1e-9) | merged['price_changed'] | merged['instances_changed']]
print("\nChanged resources (10-12 vs 10-13):")
print(changed.to_string())
print("\nTotal delta from changed:", changed['cost_delta'].sum())
